summary: Product-scoped record for Bitpanda Earn, the current umbrella spanning proof-of-stake rewards and stablecoin yield products. First-party materials document Bitpanda Staking from May 2022 and the addition of Earn on Stablecoins to the Bitpanda Earn suite in November 2025.
what_happened: Bitpanda launched Staking on 10 May 2022 with weekly rewards. On 13 November 2025 Bitpanda introduced Earn on Stablecoins as an addition to its Bitpanda Earn suite. Current first-party materials distinguish the mechanisms: staking rewards derive from proof-of-stake networks, while Earn on Stablecoins is a loan/title-transfer arrangement in which ownership passes to Bitpanda for the term of the Earn transaction and the customer is exposed to Bitpanda counterparty and insolvency risk. Those terms must not be generalized across every Bitpanda Earn product.
uncertainty_notes: The reviewed sources establish Bitpanda Staking from 2022 and identify the 2025 stablecoin product as part of a new Bitpanda Earn suite, but they do not establish one unambiguous original launch date for the current umbrella. Product-specific custody, title, redemption, protection and yield-source treatment differs materially.
notes: Earn on Stablecoins is explicitly described as unregulated, not a banking or deposit product, outside regulated custody during the Earn transaction, and not covered by deposit protection. These statements apply to that product and are not extended to Bitpanda Staking.

summary: Product-scoped record for CEX.IO Earn, an exchange-hosted umbrella covering staking and Savings products. First-party material documents Staking by 2020, Savings under the Earn umbrella by April 2021, and continuing Staking and Savings after the April 2025 suspension of the older Automated Staking program.
what_happened: CEX.IO documentation describes Staking as an Earn product tied to proof-of-stake participation and Savings as a separate product in which customer funds may facilitate lending and other crypto-market activity. An 8 April 2021 first-party update states that Savings entered open beta as a full-fledged service under the CEX.IO Earn umbrella. A 26 March 2025 notice announced that Automated Crypto Staking would be suspended on 1 April 2025 while introducing an updated reward structure for continuing Staking and Savings programs. The sunset therefore applies to the older Automated Staking program, not to the whole Earn umbrella.
uncertainty_notes: The reviewed sources establish the Earn umbrella by April 2021 but do not prove its first launch date, so launch_date remains null. Current first-party Savings material also contains inconsistent presentation of Locked Savings availability; no universal current locked-product claim is made.
notes: Staking and Savings are treated as distinct product mechanisms. Jurisdictional availability, custody, legal title, redemption rules and reward rates are not generalized across all CEX.IO Earn products.
